_meta.author: Park Jae Woo (source framework); consolidated/structured with AI-assistance for Mark Litvak
_meta.purpose: Единый каталог для анализа пациентов: связывает Yang/Yin routing → энергию → симптомы/болезни/органы/меридианы/чакры/темпераменты/тайминг в один справочник. Это RESEARCH overlay, не диагностические критерии.

provenance_legend.[RF]: Park six-energy framework overlay — research construct, NOT externally validated diagnostic criteria
provenance_legend.[GL/RCT/LBL/CLASS]: standard medical facts where a disease name maps to standard nosology — valid independently of the energy overlay

governance_safety_annotation.energy_overlay_is_RF_construct: [GOVERNANCE — CRITICAL] The six-energy classification (Wind/Heat/Fire/Damp/Dry/Cold), the Yang/Yin primary routing, the energy→organ/meridian/chakra mappings, and the energy→disease nosology checklists are a Park-derived RESEARCH construct. They are NOT validated diagnostic criteria and must NEVER auto-drive diagnosis or prescribing. Standard ICD diagnosis and EBM care are primary and non-negotiable.
governance_safety_annotation.not_operationalized: This catalog is documentation only. No symptom→energy classifier, routing layer, or energy→drug filter is wired into the engine.
governance_safety_annotation.not_patient_facing: Energy/chakra/meridian/temperament vocabulary is engine-internal (Variant B) and never surfaced to the patient.
governance_safety_annotation.evidence_separation: Where an entry names a standard disease (e.g. hypertension, T2DM, ALS), that disease and its standard care are [GL/RCT]-valid independently; the energy LABEL placed on it is [RF] overlay.
governance_safety_annotation.no_hamer_aire_causality: This catalog carries no Hamer/AIRE psychic-conflict causal layer. Energy is a symptom-pattern descriptor, not a psychic-conflict etiology. KCTS governed by kcts_integration v1.1 (EBM).

energy_count_reconciliation.park_canon: SIX energies — Ветер/Wind, Тепло/Heat, Жар/Fire(Hotness), Влажность/Damp, Сухость/Dry, Холод/Cold. Park keeps Тепло (Heat — acute inflammation/hyperemia) and Жар (Fire — hypertension/obesity/sweating/metabolic) SEPARATE.
energy_count_reconciliation.engine_5_energy_canon: services/metacod_bridge.py + rule_energy_mapping.json use FIVE energies (cold/damp/dry/heat/wind). Post 01-Jun-2026 the engine MERGES Тепло+Жар into a single 'heat' axis.
energy_count_reconciliation.crosswalk: Wind=wind · Heat(Тепло)→heat · Fire(Жар)→heat (merged) · Damp=damp · Dry=dry · Cold=cold.
energy_count_reconciliation.rule: This catalog preserves Park's full SIX-energy articulation (so the Тепло/Жар distinction is not lost). When mapping to the engine, collapse Тепло+Жар→heat per the crosswalk. The RF artifacts symptom_registry_v3_0 and topographic_atlas_v6_0 also use the six-energy articulation and self-document this same merge.

_meta.kcts_v1_1_alignment: [KCTS v1.1] No Hamer/AIRE psychic-conflict causality. Energy = phenomenological symptom-pattern axis only.

usage_for_patient_analysis._note: [RF — pipeline. Documentation only; NOT operationalized; standard ICD/EBM is primary and parallel.]
usage_for_patient_analysis.step_1_polarity: Определить A (Yang) vs УМ (Yin) по yin_yang_routing.discriminators — PRIMARY ROUTING LAYER.
usage_for_patient_analysis.step_2_energy: Внутри полярности определить конкретную энергию по совпадению core_symptoms + universal_symptom_map + pain_differential + meteorological_trigger + temperament + emotions + timing.
usage_for_patient_analysis.step_3_system_localize: Сверить с clinical_systems по поражённой системе (нозологические чек-листы по энергиям).
usage_for_patient_analysis.step_4_windows_sensory: Подтвердить через windows (внешние индикаторы) и сенсорную/кожную диагностику.
usage_for_patient_analysis.step_5_crosswalk: Свернуть Тепло+Жар→heat при отображении в 5-энергетический движок (energy_count_reconciliation.crosswalk).
usage_for_patient_analysis.step_6_link_rf: Связать энергию → symptom_registry (6-Ki × histogenetic × phase × membrane drift) → topographic_atlas (tissue × 6-Ki × redox → ICD-10 + membrane code) → nosology registries → diagnostic_db (TST/IMG/FUN/PRO для подтверждения) → drug_db (DRG-* по membrane-direction).
usage_for_patient_analysis.governance_reminder: Энергия — это RF-дескриптор паттерна симптомов, а НЕ диагноз и НЕ показание к препарату. ICD-диагностика и EBM-лечение первичны и не задерживаются.
